notes: has_gender is functional and has_head o has_gender ⊑ has_gender (RELATIONS.md). Class rules are GCIs on has_gender value g. 'A noun takes one definite article' is a firm Func(def_article) (def_article carries no tag; the question presupposes one article). The adjective ending pattern is the object of indef_adj_pattern, with the surface of the adjective form ('dünnes' and 'dünne') on the pattern individuals.

bridge_refs.bastel_head: 'Bastelbuch' is a German compound whose last element, its head, is 'Buch'.
bridge_refs.bucher_plural: 'Bücher' is the plural of the German noun 'Buch'.
bridge_refs.fem_adj: In German, after an indefinite article, an adjective before a feminine noun in the nominative singular ends in '-e', as in 'eine große Stadt'.
bridge_refs.fem_article: In German, a feminine noun takes the definite article 'die' in the nominative singular.
